summary.headline: Critical findings need attention. Some checks could not be completed.
summary.coverage: 3 of 4 applicable checks evaluated; 1 not applicable.

checks.title: Local disk capacity
checks.rule: WARNING if free <= 15% OR <= 10 GiB; CRITICAL if free <= 5% OR <= 2 GiB. Critical overrides warning; boundaries are inclusive.
checks.interpretation: One or more local volumes have limited free capacity.
checks.next_step: Review storage usage and free space; no files are changed by this tool.
checks.limitations: Does not assess disk wear or all possible mounts; filesystem reads can block.

checks.title: Microsoft Defender status
checks.interpretation: Security status cannot be inferred from missing evidence.
checks.limitations: No actual device was inspected; other antivirus tools are not evaluated.

checks.title: CPU utilization
checks.rule: WARNING at >= 85%; CRITICAL at >= 95%; boundaries inclusive.
checks.interpretation: This snapshot did not cross a utilization threshold.
checks.limitations: A short sampled interval is not sustained workload analysis.

checks.title: Memory utilization
checks.rule: WARNING at >= 85%; CRITICAL at >= 95%; boundaries inclusive.
checks.interpretation: This snapshot did not cross a utilization threshold.
checks.limitations: One sample does not diagnose a leak or determine adequate RAM.

checks.title: Battery charge
checks.rule: If unplugged: WARNING at <= 20% charge; CRITICAL at <= 10%; otherwise informational.
checks.interpretation: A battery is not reported on this machine.
checks.limitations: Battery may be unreported by the OS.

collection_issues.detail: This source is not available on this platform.

limitations: Not a vulnerability scanner, compliance audit, malware detector, or security certification.
Does not confirm patch compliance, antivirus efficacy, firewall policy, or active encryption.
Does not assess SMART disk health, backup restore success, or workload suitability.
One brief CPU and memory observation cannot establish sustained performance or memory leaks.
Reported interface link speed is not measured throughput; link-up does not prove internet access.
Local filesystem calls can block in the operating system; Python cannot impose a hard timeout on them.
Hardware and battery values may be unavailable or inaccurate in virtual environments.
